pageDescription: Search and filter Prism Bloom Exercise routes by name, activity, route type, difficulty, distance, location, or enter a ZIP code to search nearby routes.
Route information is currently being expanded as Prism Bloom Exercise continues to grow. The route library is transitioning to a new data-driven system that stores route details.
During this transition, some routes may have limited information available while route data is being reviewed, mapped, and added.
If a route appears incomplete, additional information is still being documented and will be added as it becomes available.
